# Leyline

> Organizations\, their graphs and the graphs\' histories\.

Every page below is Markdown. Requests are JSON over HTTP; each operation's page gives its method and URI, its headers, its request and response with an example, its errors and its pagination. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless an operation's page says it takes no credential. Send `Crucible-Version: 2026-10-01` on every request you make. `describe.json` holds the whole reference as data (`crucible.describe/1`).

## Overview

- [Service overview](src/index.md): protocol, authentication, service errors, and the operations of each resource
- [Permissions](src/permissions.md): every permission an operation can require, by resource type

## Operations

- [ArchiveGraph](src/operations/API_ArchiveGraph.md): `POST /orgs/{organizationId}/graphs/{graphId}/archive`. A mixed list\: clients see the public clause and that more are internal\, never the internal clause or the internal member its when reads\.
- [CreateGraph](src/operations/API_CreateGraph.md): `POST /orgs/{organizationId}/graphs`.
- [ExecuteQuery](src/operations/API_ExecuteQuery.md): `POST /orgs/{organizationId}/graphs/{graphId}/query`.
- [GetGraph](src/operations/API_GetGraph.md): `GET /orgs/{organizationId}/graphs/{graph}`.
- [GetOrganization](src/operations/API_GetOrganization.md): `GET /orgs/{organizationId}`.
- [GetUser](src/operations/API_GetUser.md): `GET /user`. Answers about the caller\'s own credential\.
- [Health](src/operations/API_Health.md): `GET /health`. No authentication\: nothing to authorize\.
- [ListGraphs](src/operations/API_ListGraphs.md): `GET /orgs/{organizationId}/graphs`. Returns only the graphs the caller may read\.
- [RestoreBackup](src/operations/API_RestoreBackup.md): `POST /orgs/{organizationId}/graphs/{graphId}/histories/{historyId}/restore`.
- [RewriteGraph](src/operations/API_RewriteGraph.md): `POST /orgs/{organizationId}/graphs/{graphId}/rewrite`. Hostile documentation\: a backtick in a when literal\, and handler clause documentation that must keep its case\, its paragraphs and its code spans\.

## Data types

- [InternalServerException](src/shapes/InternalServerException.md): error, HTTP 500. An unexpected server failure\.
- [NotFoundException](src/shapes/NotFoundException.md): error, HTTP 404. The resource does not exist\, or the caller may not know that it does\.
- [ValidationException](src/shapes/ValidationException.md): error, HTTP 400. A request cannot be parsed or does not satisfy the service\'s input model\.
- [ValidationExceptionField](src/shapes/ValidationExceptionField.md): structure. A request field that failed validation\.
- [ValidationExceptionFieldList](src/shapes/ValidationExceptionFieldList.md): list.
- [ValidationExceptionReason](src/shapes/ValidationExceptionReason.md): enum. A machine\-readable reason\; clients never need to parse message text\.
- [ArchiveGraphInput](src/shapes/ArchiveGraphInput.md): structure.
- [ArchiveGraphOutput](src/shapes/ArchiveGraphOutput.md): structure.
- [CreateGraphInput](src/shapes/CreateGraphInput.md): structure.
- [CreateGraphOutput](src/shapes/CreateGraphOutput.md): structure.
- [ExecuteQueryInput](src/shapes/ExecuteQueryInput.md): structure.
- [ExecuteQueryOutput](src/shapes/ExecuteQueryOutput.md): structure.
- [GetGraphInput](src/shapes/GetGraphInput.md): structure.
- [GetGraphOutput](src/shapes/GetGraphOutput.md): structure.
- [GetOrganizationInput](src/shapes/GetOrganizationInput.md): structure.
- [GetOrganizationOutput](src/shapes/GetOrganizationOutput.md): structure.
- [GetUserOutput](src/shapes/GetUserOutput.md): structure.
- [GraphId](src/shapes/GraphId.md): string.
- [HealthOutput](src/shapes/HealthOutput.md): structure.
- [HistoryId](src/shapes/HistoryId.md): string.
- [HistoryRef](src/shapes/HistoryRef.md): structure.
- [ListGraphsInput](src/shapes/ListGraphsInput.md): structure.
- [ListGraphsOutput](src/shapes/ListGraphsOutput.md): structure.
- [Names](src/shapes/Names.md): list.
- [OrganizationId](src/shapes/OrganizationId.md): string.
- [QueryTarget](src/shapes/QueryTarget.md): union. Where a query reads\: the current state\, or a saved history\.
- [RestoreBackupInput](src/shapes/RestoreBackupInput.md): structure.
- [RestoreBackupOutput](src/shapes/RestoreBackupOutput.md): structure.
- [RewriteGraphInput](src/shapes/RewriteGraphInput.md): structure.
- [RewriteGraphOutput](src/shapes/RewriteGraphOutput.md): structure.
